caption: This drawing features a collection of fifteen square fabric swatches arranged in three vertical columns. The swatches display a variety of patterns and colors. The leftmost column has five swatches vertically aligned, including designs such as brown crosshatch with a pink flower, black wavy lines with diamond patterns on white, light purple vine with leaves on white, and floral motifs on dotted or textured backgrounds. The middle column has five patterned squares, with designs like diagonal stripes with green and pink, a red and white tessellated floral motif, blue leaves on thin black stripes, repeating brown chevrons on white, and white floral motifs on a dark purple background. The rightmost column consists of five swatches featuring horizontal purple stripes on white, green circles on a gray background, abstract small shapes, horizontal green and gold stripes with dots, and an arrangement of small ovals and circles. Additionally, there are other geometric and floral arrangements in shades of red, brown, green, blue, purple, and white, with both organic and geometric repetition among the designs; the overall background is a pale beige or off-white.
title: Textiles from Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
